label: Copy SHA-256 checksums
description: Requires Python 3. Copies one SHA-256 digest and filename per selected file to the clipboard. Set a python3 override in Settings & Paths if your installation uses python.exe.

executor.scriptBody:
import hashlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='backslashreplace')
for input_path in map(Path, sys.argv[1:]):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with input_path.open('rb') as source:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            digest.update(chunk)
    print(f'{digest.hexdigest()}  {input_path.name}')
